books.title: Trigonometry
books.subtitle: The Math of Circles, Waves, and Everything That Repeats
books.blurb: Circles, waves, and everything that repeats. The largest of the four, and a fair illustration of how much book one file will hold.

books.title: The History of Trigonometry
books.subtitle: From Chord to Sine to Wave
books.blurb: How a table of chords became the sine, and the sine became the wave. Every factual sentence carries a pointer to the source it came from.

books.title: Derivatives
books.subtitle: The Math of Breaking a Curve Down to a Single Instant
books.blurb: Breaking a curve down to a single instant. Same engine, different course, which is the whole argument for commissioning one: the machinery is proven and the content is yours.

books.title: Integrals
books.subtitle: The Math of Building a Whole Back Up from Infinite Pieces
books.blurb: Building a whole back up from infinite pieces. Exercises with hint ladders, worked solutions, and a facilitator edition generated from the same source as the student one.

books.title: The History of Calculus
books.subtitle: Twenty-Three Centuries, About Thirty People
books.blurb: Twenty-three centuries of the story behind both calculus books, written as a companion to them and linked from every section it maps to.

books.title: Discrete Math and Linear Algebra
books.subtitle: The Foundations of Math for Machine Learning
books.blurb: The foundations of math for machine learning, written for high school, college, and adult learners. Every fraction stacks properly, and the read-aloud speaks the actual math rather than around it.

books.title: The History of Discrete Math and Linear Algebra
books.subtitle: The Math Behind Machine Learning, Twenty-Five Centuries in the Making
books.blurb: Twenty-five centuries of people who were mostly not building the mathematics machine learning now runs on: counting poems, arguing about dice, sorting bridges.
